newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 19.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Hwang Jang-yop, North Korea's top ideologue, arrives in the Philippines, will go to South Korea at later date.
Illegitimate Taiwan investments in China to face maximum fine of T$15 million (US$545,000).
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Government information to be brought under public scrutiny.
Government agencies to crack down on illegal China investments.
LIBERTY TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui says Taiwan needs to spend 30 years to become completely democratic.
President Lee Teng-hui says there is no need to declare independence for the Republic of China.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Private sector interested to participate in development of Taipei International Finance Centre.
Communist Chinese authorities keep Taiwan investment private in bid to avoid Taiwan's tightening policy towards investments on the Chinese mainland.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Government tightens rules to curb China investment.
Central bank forcefully mops up a total of T$15 billion (US$545 million) in funds. (US$1 = T$27.5)
